import json
U="UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet."
O="editor_toolset.toolsets.object.ObjectTools."
A="editor_toolset.toolsets.asset.AssetTools."
def call(name,args):
    result=execute_tool(name,json.dumps(args));assert "returnValue" in result,(name,result)
    return result["returnValue"]
def ref(x):return x["refPath"] if isinstance(x,dict) else x
def run():
    changed=[]
    for name in ["WBP_UICatch","WBP_UIHUDExtras","WBP_UILoading","WBP_UIBoss","WBP_UIAlert"]:
        asset="/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/"+name
        assert not call(A+"is_dirty",{"asset_path":asset})
        bp={"refPath":asset+"."+name}
        tree=call(U+"GetWidgets",{"widgetBlueprint":bp})
        for node in tree["widgets"]:
            if ref(node["widgetClassPath"])!="/Script/MessControl.MCUniversalUIWidget":continue
            target=node["widget"]
            schema=json.loads(call(O+"list_properties",{"instance":target}))
            label=next(key for key in schema if key.lower()=="label")
            labelkey=next(key for key in schema if key.lower()=="labelkey")
            old=call(O+"get_properties",{"instance":target,"properties":[label,labelkey]})
            assert call(O+"set_properties",{"instance":target,"values":json.dumps({label:"",labelkey:"None"})})
            changed.append({"asset":asset,"widget":node["widgetName"],"old":old})
        assert call(U+"CompileWidgetBlueprint",{"widgetBlueprint":bp})
        assert call(A+"save_assets",{"asset_paths":[asset]})
    return {"decorativeLabelsCleared":changed,"policy":"Only task-owned new shapes; no buttons or source owner labels changed"}
